:::{#cor-hazard-ratio-diffloghaz}

#### Hazard ratio vs difference of log-hazards

$$\hr(t| \vx : \vxs) = \expf{\diffloghaz(t|\vx: \vxs)}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

This derivation uses @thm-diff-loghaz.

$$
\ba
\hr(t| \vx : \vxs)
&= \expf{\logf{\hr(t| \vx : \vxs)}} && \text{(inverse relationship between exponential and logarithm)} \\
&= \expf{\diffloghaz(t|\vx: \vxs)} && \text{(applying the log-hazard-difference theorem)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-hazard-ratio-vs-difference-of-1}

:::
